title: Symbol Population Matrix Wave 004 — What Is Dense, What Is Sparse and What Should Become Buildable
purpose: Translate accumulated symbolic research into a population map showing which structural families have enough definition, provenance and cross-links to support future Rooms, Chambers, readers or visual interfaces.
maturity_scale: seed — recurring term but weak owner/definition
rooted — canonical owner and basic distinction
branched — variants and cross-system relations mapped
fruiting — tests, boundaries, provenance and practical navigation exist
buildable — reader/task/interface can be specified without inventing ontology

families.build_signal: Can support a canonical interactive center/threshold reader using exact geometry + relational definitions.
Can support process navigation/state transitions rather than another static symbol page.

families.remaining_gap: Need public task model for switching projections without overwhelming navigation.
families.possible_build: Projection switcher: House / Temple / Body / City / Tree.

families.remaining_gap: Need stronger literal-material evidence for soil/ash/clay transformations and explicit route diagrams.
families.possible_build: Material-state transformer only after scientific/ritual routes are clearly typed.

families.remaining_gap: Need crosswalk among physical radiation/thermal process, biblical theophany and project cognition without implying physics.
families.possible_build: Lens/filter rather than Room: 'What kind of light/fire claim is this?'

families.remaining_gap: Need one combined movement diagram showing carrier vs flow vs route vs orientation.
Need passage-level provenance cards and explicit role changes over time.
families.possible_build: Specialist comparison view, not global ontology.

families.remaining_gap: Need a typed-number/time UI that blocks numerological overreach by showing claim type first.
Original user pointing/alignment claims still need primary-source reconstruction before any visual astronomical alignment tool.
families.possible_build: Coordinate-aware sky comparator only after claim recovery.

families.remaining_gap: Need source-specific compact cards and a structural-dimension matrix.
families.possible_build: Tree family comparison with toggles for roots/water/knowledge/fruit/lineage/world-order.

architectural_deduction: The project is becoming ready for interfaces based on operator type and projection switching, not more top-level pages. The highest-value future build is likely a relational explorer where the reader selects a center element and sees its states, neighboring operators, evidence layers, historical comparators and valid transitions.
build_gate: at least one confusion/test is resolved
the interface answers a real navigation/research question
adding UI does not create a second knowledge owner
